solutionSource.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

entries.clue: Upright piano in bash: tuning note ruined (8)

indicatorNotes.in: the piano's P goes inside the other pieces

blocks.note: have a bash = have a go
p = piano (soft) in music; it sits inside LOST: L(P)OST

annotation.surface: A musical party where the piano is hopelessly out of tune.
annotation.walkthrough: The surface wants 'upright piano' as one instrument; 'Upright' alone is the definition, a goalpost being an upright.
annotation.definitionFit: A goalpost is one of the two uprights of a goal.

entries.clue: Understand individual has secured manuscript, a precious item (8)

indicatorNotes.has secured: to secure something is to hold it fast, so GET holds MS fast inside itself

blocks.note: standard abbreviation, held inside GET: GE(MS)T

annotation.surface: Someone realises a lone person has got hold of a valuable old manuscript.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Has secured' is the container signal, but it belongs to 'Understand', not to 'individual' next to it.
annotation.definitionFit: A general description: a cut jewel is one example of a precious item.

entries.clue: Brightest star heads for home abruptly after a recording (5)

indicatorNotes.heads for: take the first letter of each following word
indicatorNotes.after: the H and A come after A LP

blocks.note: first letters of home and abruptly

annotation.surface: A pop star rushes home the moment a recording session ends.
annotation.walkthrough: The surface's 'star' is a celebrity; the definition means the astronomical one. Alpha is the name given to the brightest star in a constellation, as in Alpha Centauri.
annotation.definitionFit: An astronomer's naming convention: stars in each constellation take Greek letters in order of brightness, so the first letter labels the brightest.

entries.clue: Public meeting to urge diet? (5,10)

blocks.note: press = urge, as in pressing someone to act
a diet is a formal assembly, as in the Diet of Worms

annotation.surface: A gathering held to encourage people to slim.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Diet' wants to be about food; here it is the old word for a legislative assembly or conference. The question mark flags that twist.
annotation.definitionFit: A press conference is a meeting held publicly for journalists.

entries.clue: Foolish person in school mess (7)

blocks.note: sch. is the abbreviation for school

annotation.surface: An idiot lands in trouble at school.
annotation.walkthrough: 'In' looks like a container signal but is only a link: the foolish person is found in the wordplay.
annotation.definitionFit: Schmuck is Yiddish-derived slang for a fool.

entries.clue: Fight doctor in film (6)

indicatorNotes.in: the doctor is placed in the film, so his letters sit inside it

blocks.note: a film of paint is a coat
MB = Bachelor of Medicine, a doctor's degree; it goes between CO and AT

annotation.surface: A brawl involving a doctor in a movie.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Film' reads as a movie; it is a thin layer, a coat.
annotation.definitionFit: Combat means fight, as noun or verb.

entries.clue: I will avoid describing original server as excellent (2,3,5,5)

indicatorNotes.will avoid: the I is left out of WAITER

blocks.note: a picture of X describes X
a server is a WAITER; drop the I

annotation.surface: A diner praises the first waiter they had, while insisting on not describing him.
annotation.walkthrough: The phrase comes from diamonds, graded by their clarity or 'water'; a stone of the first water is of the best quality.
annotation.definitionFit: Of the first water means of the highest quality, excellent.

entries.clue: Lives in this place will retain power where life exists (9)

indicatorNotes.will retain: BIOS HERE holds P between its parts

blocks.note: P = power in physics, kept between the other two pieces

annotation.surface: Life stories kept in one place still have influence where people live.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Lives' reads as a verb; here it is the plural noun, biographies.
annotation.definitionFit: The biosphere is the part of the Earth where living things exist.

entries.clue: Saunter to end of road and do nothing after one leaves (6)

indicatorNotes.end of: take the last letter of road
indicatorNotes.after: points to the removal happening once IDLE is placed

blocks.note: IDLE = do nothing, with one (I) leaving

annotation.surface: Someone strolls to the end of the road and lazes once a companion has gone.
annotation.walkthrough: 'One' is the Roman numeral I, the letter that leaves IDLE.
annotation.definitionFit: To toddle is to walk in a leisurely way, to saunter.

entries.clue: People attending American University fancy food at the Sorbonne? (6)

blocks.note: the gate is the number of spectators at an event

annotation.surface: Students at an American college hanker after the fine food served at a Paris university.
annotation.walkthrough: The Sorbonne is a Paris university, signalling a French word; gâteau is French for cake. 'Fancy' is an adjective here, not an anagram signal.
annotation.definitionFit: A gateau is a rich, elaborate cake: fancy food, and French.

entries.clue: Chap hogging last of syrup — from this? (5)

annotation.definitionNote: the definition points back to syrup: the tree that syrup comes from

indicatorNotes.last of: take the last letter of syrup

blocks.note: last letter of syrup, held in the middle of the chap

annotation.surface: A man greedily keeping the last of the syrup to himself.
annotation.walkthrough: The definition is 'from this?', i.e. the source of syrup, which is the maple tree.
annotation.definitionFit: Maple syrup is made from the sap of the maple tree.

entries.clue: Hard material — too hard, we fancy (9)

indicatorNotes.fancy: fancy as a verb: let the letters be imagined in a new arrangement

annotation.surface: Someone complains a material is too tough for them.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Hard' appears in both definition and fodder; only the second is letters.
annotation.definitionFit: Heartwood is the dense, hard inner wood of a tree trunk.

entries.clue: Schools silent after dismissing current change (9)

indicatorNotes.after dismissing: dismissing means sending away, so the current's letter is sent out of the word

blocks.note: I = electric current, the letter dismissed

annotation.surface: Schools falling quiet after a change of electricity supply.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Schools' is a verb, trains; I is the physics symbol for current.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym, from the alchemists' dream of turning lead into gold: to alter the very nature of something.

entries.clue: Get rid of devious character seen around Times page (5)

indicatorNotes.seen around: the character is seen hanging around the other letters, so it surrounds them

blocks.note: a slippery, devious person is an eel
p = page; with X it sits inside the eel

annotation.surface: Ousting a crook spotted hanging around a newspaper page.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Times' looks like the newspaper; it is the multiplication sign X.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym, as when a school throws out a pupil for good.

entries.clue: Clear with agreement to adopt Republican broadcasting company (7)

indicatorNotes.to adopt: to adopt is to take in as one's own, so the agreement takes the Republican into itself

blocks.note: to clear a profit is to net it

annotation.surface: A TV channel cleared to take on a Republican by agreement.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Clear' means to make as profit, net.
annotation.definitionFit: A broadcasting sense: a chain of linked stations, as with the big American TV networks.

entries.clue: Pursue clubs, perhaps, for training gear (9)

blocks.note: clubs is one example of a suit in cards

annotation.surface: Chasing golf clubs to use in practice.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Clubs' suggests golf; it is the card suit, and 'perhaps' marks it as one example of a suit.
annotation.definitionFit: A definition by use: the loose top and trousers athletes wear to warm up and train.

entries.clue: One not quoted abandoning chapter (6)

indicatorNotes.abandoning: abandoning means leaving behind, so the chapter's letter is left out of the word

blocks.note: UNCITED = not quoted, without the C

annotation.surface: A passage left unquoted once a chapter is dropped.
annotation.walkthrough: The definition 'One' is an adjective here, as in 'they are one', united.
annotation.definitionFit: An adjective sense of 'one': a couple who are one in purpose are joined together.

entries.clue: Working to death, working without hint of alleviation? Exactly (2,3,3)

indicatorNotes.Working: the letters of 'to death' are worked into a new order
indicatorNotes.without: without means lacking, so the phrase must go without that one letter
indicatorNotes.hint of: take the first letter of alleviation

blocks.note: a machine that is on is working
anagram fodder once the A goes
A, the first letter of alleviation, removed

annotation.surface: Someone being worked to death with no relief at all.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Working' appears twice: the first signals the anagram, the second is ON.
annotation.definitionFit: An idiom: arriving when the clock's hand is on the dot marking the hour, precisely.

entries.clue: Fussed vaguely, satisfied to be welcoming a couple of females (6)

indicatorNotes.to be welcoming: a host welcoming guests takes them inside, so FED takes these letters in

blocks.note: A plus two Fs, f being the abbreviation for female

annotation.surface: A well-fed host dithering over the arrival of two women guests.
annotation.walkthrough: To faff about is British slang for fussing around without achieving much.
annotation.definitionFit: Faffed means fussed ineffectually, dithered.

entries.clue: Welshman, finally losing heart, accommodated by father and daughter (6)

indicatorNotes.losing heart: FINALLY drops all its middle letters
indicatorNotes.accommodated by: to be accommodated is to be given lodging, so the remnant is housed inside the father

blocks.note: FINALLY without its inner letters; DA(FY)D

annotation.surface: A Welshman who eventually lost his nerve, taken in by his family.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Finally' is the fodder here, not an adverb. Dafydd is the Welsh form of David.
annotation.definitionFit: Dafydd is a typical Welsh man's name, standing for any Welshman.

entries.clue: Advertisement possibly attached to new gate (7)

blocks.note: a poster is one kind of advertisement

annotation.surface: An ad stuck onto a freshly built gate.
annotation.walkthrough: A postern is a back or side gate, especially in a castle wall.
annotation.definitionFit: A specific kind: the small back or side gate in a castle or city wall.

entries.clue: Mate shipping oars, drifting in shade (7)

indicatorNotes.shipping: PAL takes the oars on board
indicatorNotes.drifting: the letters of oars wander into a new order

blocks.note: the letters of OARS rearranged, taken aboard between the A and L of the mate

annotation.surface: A rower resting in the shade, oars shipped and boat drifting.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Shipping oars' is real rowing language for bringing them into the boat; here it puts the letters inside PAL.
annotation.definitionFit: Shade by metonymy: the light umbrella held up to give shade from the sun, from Italian 'para sole', guard against sun.

entries.clue: Rubbish suggestion mostly thrown up in computer program (6)

indicatorNotes.thrown up: in a down clue, the letters are turned upwards

blocks.note: IDEA, a suggestion, minus its last letter

annotation.surface: A dud idea thrown up by a piece of software.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Thrown up' reverses ROT IDE, which is natural in a down clue.
annotation.definitionFit: An editor is a program for writing and changing text or code.

entries.clue: Dark changes enveloping area in African city (5)

indicatorNotes.enveloping: the rearranged DARK wraps around A

blocks.note: a = area, enveloped by the shuffled DARK

annotation.surface: A gloomy change coming over part of an African city.
annotation.walkthrough: Dakar is the capital of Senegal.
annotation.definitionFit: A definition by category: the capital of Senegal, on the westernmost point of mainland Africa.

entries.clue: Texas city accommodating couples runs this? Not half (4,5)

indicatorNotes.Not half: only half of THIS is used

blocks.note: a table for two accommodates a couple

annotation.surface: A Texas city where hotels welcome couples; not half, says the reply.
annotation.walkthrough: The definition comes first; the wordplay is FOR TWO + R + TH. 'Not half' works on 'this' alone.
annotation.definitionFit: A definition by category: the city that grew from an army post, paired with Dallas in north Texas.

entries.clue: Novel of Paris and of another city (5)

blocks.note: the French word for a novel: 'of Paris' means in French
the adjective for the Italian capital

annotation.surface: A book about Paris and another city.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Of Paris' means in French, not set in Paris.
annotation.definitionFit: Roman is the French word for a novel, and also means of Rome.

entries.clue: Rippling nude torso — beefy stuff (9)

indicatorNotes.Rippling: the letters move like rippling muscles into a new order

annotation.surface: A muscular bare chest, the very picture of beefiness.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Beefy' seems to describe the torso; it is literal: tournedos are beef steaks.
annotation.definitionFit: Tournedos are small round steaks cut from beef fillet.

entries.clue: Returned lots of cotton — it’s shrinking (5)

indicatorNotes.lots of: lots of something is a large part of it rather than the whole, so the fabric loses its final letter

blocks.note: DIMITY is a cotton fabric; drop its last letter

annotation.surface: Cotton sent back because it shrinks in the wash.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Shrinking' suggests laundry; it means shy, as in a shrinking violet. Dimity is a light striped cotton.
annotation.definitionFit: Shrinking means timid, shying away.

entries.clue: Excessive energy in sailors is not good (6)

indicatorNotes.in: the excess and energy are found in among the sailors, so their letters sit inside

blocks.note: RN = Royal Navy, split around the other letters

annotation.surface: Too much exuberance among sailors is a bad thing.
annotation.walkthrough: RN is the Royal Navy, a common source of sailors in British crosswords.
annotation.definitionFit: A colloquial sense: decayed fruit gives the informal 'rotten' for anything poor or unpleasant.

entries.clue: Wind player at home tucking into wine (8)

indicatorNotes.tucking into: to tuck into something is to get stuck inside it, so these letters go into the wine

blocks.note: in = at home, placed inside the wine

annotation.surface: A flatulent musician staying home to drink wine.
annotation.walkthrough: 'Wind player' reads as a musician; the definition is the instrument that plays wind.
annotation.definitionFit: A clarinet is a woodwind instrument, a player of wind in a sense.
